title: Noise operator bound by Fourier degree
statement: Let $\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $\rho\ge1$, let $f$ be real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $k\in\mathbb N$. If the Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k$, then the uniform $L^2$ norm of the noise operator with parameter $\rho$ applied to $f$ is at most $\rho^k$ times the uniform $L^2$ norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: f is real-valued on the n-dimensional sign cube
The Fourier degree of f is at most k
